name: CG · 01 Intake
description: Entry points: authenticated webhook API (POST /webhook/content) and a web form (/form/content-form). Both run the content pipeline and return JSON or an HTML preview.

parameters.formDescription: Enter a topic to get a 500-800 word piece and a matching AI image in about a minute. "Auto" picks a format that has not been used recently for related topics.

values.placeholder: e.g. How AI is changing the dealership service lane

parameters.content:
## CG · 01 Intake
Two front doors into the same pipeline.

**API** `POST /webhook/content` with header `X-API-Key`:
```json
{ "topic": "...", "style": "auto|article|guide|opinion|trend_analysis|listicle",
  "audience": "", "tone": "", "word_target": 650, "image_aspect": "16:9",
  "include_image_base64": false }
```
200 success / needs_review / partial, 400 rejected, 502 model failure, 500/504 workflow error.

**Form** `/form/content-form`: same fields, shows the article and image when done.

nodeGroups.name: API request
nodeGroups.description: Normalizes the JSON body, runs the content pipeline and maps its result to an HTTP status and JSON response.

nodeGroups.name: Form request
nodeGroups.description: Normalizes the form fields, runs the content pipeline and renders the article and image as the completion page.
